errors.text_span: 该图表包含12个独立的蓝色柱子
errors.evidence: The chart contains 13 bars, one for each of the 13 categories shown on the x-axis, not 12.
The category with the shortest bar is “被约谈” (Being Summoned for a Talk). The category “被否决” (Rejected) does not appear on the chart.
The description incorrectly states that the sorting logic is not clear and that the bars are not sorted by value. The bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their values from left to right.
